name: AI With Me

sources.title: Submit Your AI Tools Here - AI With Me
Launching Your Tools on AI With Me - pricing

requirements: Product must be an AI tool; sites that 'don't meet the characteristics of the AI tool' are not included
Submitted website must be publicly accessible; inaccessible sites are rejected
Site appears to operate paid-only: the submit form only offers 'One-time submit' $19.9 and 'Unlimited submit AI' $29.9/mo tiers
preparation: Website name and website URL (the form only asks these two fields)
Payment method for $19.9 one-time (or $29.9/mo unlimited) listing
Ensure the site has crawlable landing content: AI With Me generates the listing page, description and screenshot by crawling your URL
workflow: Enter website name and website URL
Select submit type: One-time submit ($19.9) or Unlimited submit AI ($29.9/mo)
Pay; AI With Me crawls the site and auto-generates the tool page within ~48 hours for one-time (24h for unlimited)
Optional: generate an API key at /my/api-keys/ for bulk/programmatic submission
watchFor: The FAQ still references 'free submissions' with longer waits, but no free option is presented on the submit or pricing pages as of retrieval
Updating an AI-generated listing after publication costs extra unless you hold the unlimited plan
Paid sponsors get sticky homepage placement; one-time listings can sink below the fold as new tools arrive
Refund only if the product is not included after paid submission
Guest posts / link insert and 'Update AI' are separate paid products - do not confuse them with a listing
countsAsLive: A generated tool page on aiwith.me (built from the crawled site) is publicly reachable and the tool appears in the directory listing.
unknowns: Whether any free submission tier still exists (FAQ mentions it, but the current submit form shows only paid options)
Exact review/approval criteria beyond 'must be an AI tool' and 'site must be accessible'
